overview.headline: Secret summer debate that framed a new United States government

keyPoints.point: Delegates met in secret through the summer to draft a new frame of government
keyPoints.quote: Drafted in secret by delegates to the Constitutional Convention during the summer of 1787

keyPoints.point: The Convention convened in Philadelphia to revise the existing plan of union
keyPoints.quote: The Federal Convention convened in the State House (Independence Hall) in Philadelphia on May 14, 1787

keyPoints.point: Members adjourned day to day until a quorum of states was obtained
keyPoints.quote: the members adjourned from day to day until a quorum of seven states was obtained on May 25

keyPoints.point: Chief debate was how much power to allow the central government
keyPoints.quote: Among the chief points at issue were how much power to allow the central government
